meta.description: AI-powered background removal running entirely in your browser. No server uploads.
dragCornersToCrop: Drag corners or region to crop
jpegHighQualityWarning: High quality on compressed JPEG may increase file size.
steps_remove-bg_1Desc: Select a photo or graphic with a background you want to remove. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, and WebP. The image stays on your device — no server upload.
steps_remove-bg_2Desc: Click Remove Background — the AI model runs entirely in your browser. The first time may take a few seconds while the model loads and caches; subsequent runs are faster.
steps_remove-bg_3Desc: Download the transparent PNG for use in design tools, presentations, e-commerce listings, or social media.
desc: AI-powered background removal running entirely in your browser. No server uploads.
aiNotLoaded: Mode: AI smart cutout (model not loaded)
simpleMode: Mode: Simple cutout (chroma key, no model download)
downloadingModel: Loading AI model (first time ~90 MB, please wait)...
imgTooBig: Image size exceeds the browser canvas limit (16384px). Resize the image first.
imgLoadFail: Failed to load image. The file may be corrupted.
badImage: Unsupported image format. Please choose JPG / PNG / WebP
imgLoaded: Image loaded. Click “Remove Background” to start
ui.100: The difference between the two modes: AI mode uses a segmentation model to identify the subject (great for portraits, objects and complex backgrounds), but downloads about 90MB of model files and the first run is slow; simple mode removes the background by color distance (great for white or solid-color backgrounds) and needs no downloads. All processing happens in your local browser and images are never uploaded.
